player_prompt.intro:
Tiririt da Mastermind.
Yessefk ad tafem kudigu i d-yezzi {code_length} isallen, yal assel seg 1 ar {num_numbers}, {repeats}.
Di tigawt-ik, tzemreḍ ad tesekcem tigawt-ik s tseklut-agi: '[2 1 4 5]'.
Deg wakud n yal tigawt, ad yaweḍ fell-ak leqqaḍ s tseklut n yeqqaḍen ibawḍen d yeqqaḍen imellalen.
Yeqqaḍ aberkan ad yini assel i d-yezzi di tmeẓriṭ i d-yezzi, ma d yeqqaḍ amellal ad yini assel i d-yezzi di tmeẓriṭ ur d-yezzi.
Yessefk {max_turns} n tikwal i wakken ad tafeḍ kudigu.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ur d-terriḍ ara s umuɣ n uṭṭunen i ybeddlen ɣef umḍiq, yettwafernen deg tqenṭert.
invalid_move.not_integers: Isebtaren akk ilaq ad ilin d imḍanen imezwura.
invalid_move.wrong_length: Asumer-nni ilaq ad yesεu swaswa {code_length} n yiṭṭunen.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Iɣallen-nni merra ilaq ad ilin gar 1 d {num_numbers}.
invalid_move.duplicates_not_allowed: Ur ttaǧǧan ara inumak i sin.
invalid_move.repeated_guess: Tḥeqqeḍ yakan {guess}. Ttxil-k ɛreḍ ad tḥeṛṛeḍ akken nniḍen.

game_action.feedback: Tesekcem [{guess}]. Leqqaḍ: {black_pegs} n yeqqaḍen ibawḍen, {white_pegs} n yeqqaḍen imellalen.

outcome.win: Tekkit aɣbalu, tufegt {black_pegs} seg {code_length} n ujrir akken.
outcome.turn_limit: Yewweḍ-d uswir n tuqqna. Tḥeqqeḍ {percent} % seg yiṭṭunen.
